arabic text:
MUJHE KHABAR HAI KE PYAASE,
BOHOT HO TUM MERE BETE
MAGAR TUMHARI NIGAHEI(N),
NA JAAYE DARYA KINAARE
english translation text:
O’ MY SONS, I AM WELL
AWARE THAT YOU ARE EXTREMELY THIRSTY
BUT, BE MINDFUL THAT YOUR GAZE
SHOULD NOT GO TOWARDS THE RIVER BANKS

arabic text: MAA FATEMAH LAB-E-KAUSAR,\nTUMHE PILAYENGI PAANI,\nAY MERE AUN-O-MUHAMMAD
english translation text: MY MOTHER FATEMA (AS) WILL NOW\nSERVE YOU WATER ON THE BANKS\nOF KAUTHAR, O’ MY AUN AND MOHAMMED

arabic text:
TUMHE KHABAR HAI KE MAMU,
BOHOT ZAEEF HAI TERE
SUBHA SE LEKE ABHI TAK,
UNHO(N) NE LAASHEI(N) UTHAAYE
english translation text:
YOU ARE AWARE THAT YOUR UNCLE
(IMAM HUSSAIN AS) HAS BECOME VERY
WEAK FROM DAWN TILL NOW, HE
HAS BEEN CONTINUOUSLY CARRYING MARTYRS

arabic text: GIRO JO ZEE(N) SE TO KEHNA,\nFAQAT SALAAM AY DILAWAR,\nAY MERE AUN-O-MUHAMMAD
english translation text: BUT WHEN YOU FALL FROM YOUR HORSES,\nONLY SHOUT OUT SALAAM TO HIM,\nO’ MY AUN AND MOHAMMED

arabic text:
TUMHARE MAAMU KE RISHTE,
MEI JIS TARHA SE HAI DILBAR
ADAB WAFA AUR MUHABBAT,
WO AYE TUJH MEI SIMAT KAR
english translation text:
THE WAY THAT MY RELATION IS
WITH YOUR UNCLE (HUSSAIN) I PRAY
THAT YOU ALSO EXEMPLIFY THE EMBODIMENT
OF RESPECT, LOYALTY AND LOVE

arabic text: YE YAAD HO KE HO DONO,\nIK DOOSRE KE BIRAADAR,\nAY MERE AUN-O-MUHAMMAD
english translation text: REMEMBER THAT YOU ARE\nBROTHERS OF ONE ANOTHER,\nO’ MY AUN AND MOHAMMED

arabic text:
PUKAARE AUN-O-MUHAMMAD,
KALAAM MAA KA YE SUNKAR
NA SHARM AYEGI TUMKO,
NA KHOF KAR HAAYE MADAR
english translation text:
AFTER HEARING THEIR MOTHER’S ADVICE,
AUN AND MOHAMMED CRIED:
'DO NOT BE AFRAID,
WE WILL NOT EMBARRASS YOU O’ MOTHER,

arabic text: HAM IS TARHA SE LARENGE,\nKE KHUD KAHENGE YE HAIDER,\nAY MERE AUN-O-MUHAMMAD
english translation text: WE WILL FIGHT IN SUCH A WAY,\nTHAT HAIDER (AS) WILL HIMSELF SAY,\nO’ MY AUN AND MOHAMMED'

arabic text:
LARE THE AISI TARHA SE,
KAHE YE LASHKAR-E-KUFFAAR,
LO AGAYE HAI YE RAN MEI,
ALI-O-JAFFER-E-TAYYAAR
english translation text:
THEY FOUGHT SO VALIANTLY THAT
THE ARMY OF DISBELIEVERS SAID:
'LOOK, ALI (AS) AND JAFFER-E- TAYYAR
(AS) HAVE ENTERED THE BATTLEFIELD'

arabic text: KHAYAAM SE JO YE DEKHE,\nPUKARE FAKHR SE SARWAR,\nAY MERE AUN-O-MUHAMMAD
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (AS) SAW THIS FROM HIS TENT,\nHE PROUDLY CALLED OUT,\nO’ MY AUN AND MOHAMMED
